name: Hibiscus
description: Stunning tropical flowering shrub featuring large, vibrant trumpet-shaped petals with prominent nectar stamens.
careInstructions: Keep soil evenly moist, provide at least 6 hours of full sunlight daily, and protect from freezing temperatures.

name: Rose
description: Classic fragrant flowering perennial shrub adorned with delicate layers of velvety colorful petals.
careInstructions: Water at the base avoiding wet foliage, prune dead blooms regularly, and ensure nutrient-rich compost.

name: Sunflower
description: Cheerful heliotropic plant with radiant golden yellow ray florets that follow the path of the sun.
careInstructions: Water deeply twice a week, stake tall stems against strong winds, and ensure direct unshaded sunlight.

name: Marigold
description: Hardy flowering plant with ruffled bright orange and yellow blooms known for natural pest-repelling properties.
careInstructions: Allow topsoil to dry slightly between waterings, pinch off spent flowers to encourage continuous blooming.

name: Jasmine
description: Intensely fragrant climbing shrub with star-shaped white blossoms widely cherished for natural aroma.
careInstructions: Provide trellis support for climbing vines, water when topsoil feels dry, and prune after the blooming season.

name: Bougainvillea
description: Thorny ornamental climber renowned for its vibrant, papery magenta, pink, or purple floral bracts.
careInstructions: Drought-tolerant once established. Water deeply but infrequently; thrives in dry, sunny, and warm spots.

name: Tulsi
description: Sacred holy basil plant with aromatic, highly therapeutic and immune-boosting herbal foliage.
careInstructions: Water daily in warm seasons, pinch off flowering tops to encourage bushier leaf growth.

name: Money Plant
description: Lush cascading heart-leaf foliage with marbled gold variegation, known for air purification and resilience.
careInstructions: Water when top 2 inches of soil are dry, wipe leaves occasionally to remove dust, thrives in water or soil.

name: Aloe Vera
description: Thick fleshy succulent with serrated edges containing soothing, vitamin-rich clear medicinal gel.
careInstructions: Water thoroughly then let soil completely dry out. Use cactus potting mix and ensure excellent pot drainage.

name: Snake Plant
description: Indestructible architectural upright leaves with silver-green banded patterns, exceptional night-time oxygen release.
careInstructions: Very low maintenance. Water sparingly once every 2 weeks, avoid letting water sit in the leaf rosette.

name: Peace Lily
description: Elegant glossy deep-green leaves complemented by pure white sail-like spathe blooms that naturally purify indoor air.
careInstructions: Keep soil consistently moist but never soggy. Drooping leaves clearly signal when watering is needed.

name: Spider Plant
description: Graceful arching ribbon leaves with creamy central stripes producing dangling baby spiderettes.
careInstructions: Water with room-temperature water when soil surface dries, mist occasionally in dry weather.

name: Jade Plant
description: Tree-like succulent featuring plump jade-green oval leaves symbolizing luck, growth, and prosperity.
careInstructions: Allow soil to dry out between waterings. Place near a sunny windowsill for vibrant ruby-edged leaves.

name: ZZ Plant
description: Ultra-hardy drought-tolerant foliage with shiny waxy feather-like leaflets and underground water-storing tubers.
careInstructions: Thrives on neglect. Water only when soil is completely dry, tolerates low-light corners effortlessly.

name: Monstera
description: Iconic tropical Swiss Cheese plant showcasing dramatic natural leaf perforations and deep green fenestrations.
careInstructions: Water when top 50% of soil is dry, provide moss pole support for vertical climbing growth.

name: Orchid
description: Exotic moth orchid displaying long-lasting graceful blooms in white, pink, violet, and speckled tones.
careInstructions: Plant in chunky bark mix, water under running tap weekly letting all water drain out, never sit roots in water.

name: Fern
description: Lush feather-like arching fronds adding soft texture and high humidity tolerance to indoor spaces.
careInstructions: Keep soil uniformly moist and mist fronds frequently; perfect for bathrooms and humid balconies.

name: Bamboo Palm
description: Multi-stemmed tropical indoor palm with delicate feather fronds resembling miniature bamboo clusters.
careInstructions: Water thoroughly when top inch of soil is dry, avoid placing in cold drafty areas.

name: Neem Tree
description: Resilient tropical evergreen shade tree renowned for natural medicinal, antibacterial, and air-cleansing properties.
careInstructions: Thrives outdoors in full direct sunshine, water regularly during early seedling stage.

name: Banyan Tree
description: Majestic sacred canopy tree with spreading branches, aerial prop roots, and thick leathery green leaves.
careInstructions: Needs expansive space and full sun outdoors, or trained as a magnificent bonsai specimen.

name: Pine Tree
description: Coniferous evergreen tree characterized by aromatic needle foliage, wood cones, and cool climate adaptability.
careInstructions: Ensure well-drained acidic soil and ample direct sun, water moderately during hot dry spells.

name: Ficus Tree
description: Graceful weeping fig tree featuring dense arching branches covered in glossy emerald-green leaves.
careInstructions: Keep away from sudden temperature drafts, water when top 2 inches of soil feel dry.

name: Mango Tree
description: Tropical fruit-bearing canopy tree with glossy lanceolate leaves and aromatic golden summer fruit.
careInstructions: Plant in deep, well-draining soil with maximum sunlight exposure, water regularly during flowering.

name: Gulmohar Tree
description: Spectacular ornamental tree famous for fiery orange-scarlet flowers and delicate feathery foliage.
careInstructions: Requires wide open sunny space, highly drought-tolerant once roots are established.

name: Tomato
description: Fast-growing garden vegetable plant producing fragrant herbaceous leaves and juicy red culinary fruits.
careInstructions: Water consistently at base to prevent blossom rot, provide sturdy stake or tomato cage for fruit weight.

name: Mint
description: Fast-spreading aromatic culinary herb with refreshing serrated spearmint leaves and cool soothing scent.
careInstructions: Keep soil rich and consistently damp, grow in containers to manage vigorous root runners.

name: Lavender
description: Mediterranean aromatic shrub adorned with spikes of soothing violet blossoms and calming essential oils.
careInstructions: Plant in gritty well-draining soil with full sun, water sparingly to prevent root moisture rot.
